description: Frozen latest live gas records from the run-46 export (Monthly Scrape of 2026-11-20, scrape run 46) for the method 7D-2 tests: each utility's general-service classes, the residential records that also serve the commercial models (Union 01/M1, ATCO Low Use), Energir D1 and Liberty SGS, and examples of the classes left out (contract, interruptible, seasonal).
